invariants.rationale: clusteringGroup should reference a valid HoodieClusteringGroup for the method to operate correctly.
instantTime is required to read records for a cluster group and must not be null.
The list of file slices for the group should be available to process records.
instantTime should not be an empty string, as it represents a specific clustering commit instant.
There should be at least one file slice in the group to retrieve records from.
